policy.example_source_set: candidate canonical tree UNION candidate aliases UNION context canonical trees UNION context aliases UNION donor canonical trees UNION donor aliases
policy.rule_1: a quarantined source contributes to no partition
policy.rule_2: a candidate whose surviving context is empty is excluded (fail closed)
policy.rule_3: a source still shared by both model-selection unions is removed from the side where it is not a candidate, or from both sides if it is a candidate on neither
policy.rule_4: iterate to a fixpoint; non-convergence raises instead of passing
policy.donor_policy: donors are drawn from the candidate own surviving context, so donor leakage is structural; no generator exists yet
